description:
Configure the notification channels for the Flight Crew View app to reduce distractions while keeping critical updates. 

1. Open the Android System Settings for the 'Flight Crew View' app notifications.
2. Review the available channels.
3. KEEP ENABLED only flight-critical channels (related to: flight status, alerts, changes, chat, messages).
4. DISABLE all non-essential channels (related to: tips, promotions, general updates, etc).
5. Create a file at '/sdcard/notification_config.txt' listing the final state of each channel (format: 'channel_name: enabled' or 'channel_name: disabled').
